say:1:1510950001:1.text: The Wildborn have suffered terrible losses. Azora...
say:1:1510950001:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔伤亡惨重。奥法迦……
say:1:1510950001:1.male: The Wildborn have suffered terrible losses. Azora...
say:1:1510950001:1.female: The Wildborn have suffered terrible losses. Azora...

say:2:1510950002:1.source_cn: 你们什么时候出发，去击溃她？

choice_prompt:3:1510950002.source_cn: 你们什么时候出发，去击溃她？

say:4:1510950003:1.text: I'd love to be the one to kill her myself.
say:4:1510950003:1.male: I'd love to be the one to kill her myself.
say:4:1510950003:1.female: I'd love to be the one to kill her myself.

say:5:1510950004:1.text: But that mage was right. My weapon was a gift from her. It's useless against her.
say:5:1510950004:1.source_cn: 但那个魔法师说的没错。我的武器是狩猎神赐予，对她没用。
say:5:1510950004:1.male: But that mage was right. My weapon was a gift from her. It's useless against her.
say:5:1510950004:1.female: But that mage was right. My weapon was a gift from her. It's useless against her.

say:6:1510950005:1.text: I know my limits, and I know when I'm outmatched.
say:6:1510950005:1.source_cn: 我有自知之明。知道哪些对手力所不及。
say:6:1510950005:1.male: I know my limits, and I know when I'm outmatched.
say:6:1510950005:1.female: I know my limits, and I know when I'm outmatched.

say:7:1510950006:1.text: The Wildborn still need me. Kordan needs help.
say:7:1510950006:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔用得上我，戈丹需要帮手。
say:7:1510950006:1.male: The Wildborn still need me. Kordan needs help.
say:7:1510950006:1.female: The Wildborn still need me. Kordan needs help.

choice_prompt:8:1510950006.text: The Wildborn still need me. Kordan needs help.
choice_prompt:8:1510950006.source_cn: 雅库伯尔用得上我，戈丹需要帮手。
choice_prompt:8:1510950006.male: The Wildborn still need me. Kordan needs help.
choice_prompt:8:1510950006.female: The Wildborn still need me. Kordan needs help.

say:9:1510950007:1.text: Not anymore. The one who betrayed the Wildborn was the Hunting Goddess.
say:9:1510950007:1.source_cn: 现在不是了。背弃雅库伯尔的是狩猎神。
say:9:1510950007:1.male: Not anymore. The one who betrayed the Wildborn was the Hunting Goddess.
say:9:1510950007:1.female: Not anymore. The one who betrayed the Wildborn was the Hunting Goddess.

say:10:1510950008:1.text: Slaying her... that's your task now.
say:10:1510950008:1.male: Slaying her... that's your task now.
say:10:1510950008:1.female: Slaying her... that's your task now.

choice_prompt:11:1510950008.text: Slaying her... that's your task now.
choice_prompt:11:1510950008.male: Slaying her... that's your task now.
choice_prompt:11:1510950008.female: Slaying her... that's your task now.

say:12:1510950009:1.text: It's related to the Bloodhunt Festival.
say:12:1510950009:1.male: It's related to the Bloodhunt Festival.
say:12:1510950009:1.female: It's related to the Bloodhunt Festival.

say:13:1510950012:1.text: Stop wasting time. Come back with good news. We'll talk then.
say:13:1510950012:1.source_cn: 别再浪费时间，一切等你们带着好消息回来再说。
say:13:1510950012:1.male: Stop wasting time. Come back with good news. We'll talk then.
say:13:1510950012:1.female: Stop wasting time. Come back with good news. We'll talk then.

say:14:1510950013:1.text: ... Come back alive. Don't make me go avenge you.
say:14:1510950013:1.source_cn: ……平安回来，别等我去给你们报仇。
say:14:1510950013:1.male: ... Come back alive. Don't make me go avenge you.
say:14:1510950013:1.female: ... Come back alive. Don't make me go avenge you.

choice:11:0:1.text: I'm curious why you hate her so much.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 我很好奇你想杀狩猎神的原因
choice:11:0:1.male: I'm curious why you hate her so much.
choice:11:0:1.female: I'm curious why you hate her so much.

say:17:1510950011:1.text: But I believe in your power, in the strength of these mages... and in your judgment.
say:17:1510950011:1.source_cn: 但我相信你和那些魔法师的力量，还有<male>他</m...
say:17:1510950011:1.male: But I believe in your power, in the strength of these mages... and in your judgment.
say:17:1510950011:1.female: But I believe in your power, in the strength of these mages... and in your judgment.

choice:11:1:2.text: Why is your other soul sure she'll fall?
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 你的另一个灵魂怎么知道狩猎神会陨落？
choice:11:1:2.male: Why is your other soul sure she'll fall?
choice:11:1:2.female: Why is your other soul sure she'll fall?

choice:8:0:1.text: But he sees you as a traitor!
choice:8:0:1.male: But he sees you as a traitor!
choice:8:0:1.female: But he sees you as a traitor!

choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 你不准备和我们一起去？

choice:3:1:2.text: Just came to ask if you're joining.
choice:3:1:2.male: Just came to ask if you're joining.
choice:3:1:2.female: Just came to ask if you're joining.
